lore.glimmerfolk: Developed and decent undercity districts in Ambrel and a few other cities; not caves by default.
lore.crest_folk: Limestone valleys and quarry towns; warmth not specified.
lore.greyhides: Cold northern coasts and tidal islands; insulated bodies comfortable in cold water.
